goal: Play the game as a real player would: Each player gets a bright plot with a dropper that spawns a 1-cash cube every 2 seconds onto a conveyor. The conveyor carries cubes to a collector at the end, and the server adds each cube's value to the player's Cash leaderstat and destroys the cube. Two buy pads sit off to the side of the walking area: a second dropper for 25 cash and a faster conveyor for 5
summary: The playtester opened the shop and pressed buy buttons for Dropper 2, Silver Ore and Dropper 3, plus the Rebirth button and altar. The core tycoon loop worked: cubes dropped and were collected (82 dropped, 79 collected), Cash rose from 0 to about 399, and the probe recorded dropper_bought=2 and conveyor_bought=1. The probe reported no server errors. The playtester spent most of the session on UI buttons rather than the pads, and a few hints and feedback messages looked stale or missing.

bugs.title: Buy pad / 'Next' hints stay stale after the item is owned
bugs.evidence: After Dropper 2 was bought (step 3 HUD 'Upgraded: Dropper 2', Slots: 2), the touch/hint lists at steps 5-10 still show 'Dropper 2 - $25@8'. The playtester also reported the HUD 'Next: Dropper 25' hint not advancing.

bugs.title: Shop Buy button on Card_mult1 did not fire
bugs.evidence: Step 7: pressing ShopUi.Panel.List.Card_mult1.State returned done=False, 'button did NOT fire', and no purchase happened, with Cash 111 and no feedback shown. This may be a hit-test or scroll problem in the shop list rather than a playtester mistake.

bugs.title: No visible feedback when a purchase or rebirth is denied
bugs.evidence: The probe shows rebirth_denied=4 (Rebirth pressed at steps 3 and 8 with Cash under 5000, and the altar at steps 4 and 9). The only visible response was the HUD toast, and the playtester wrote that the buy buttons gave no denial feedback (steps 5-6). The Rebirth panel was never opened.

bugs.title: Shop card for Speed 1 shows 'Owned' while the playtester believed it was unbought
bugs.evidence: At step 5 the playtester saw Card_speed1 as 'Owned' with Cash 30. The probe shows conveyor_bought=1 and upgrades_bought=4, so it may have been bought legitimately by a pad touch. This is probably not a bug, but the playtester saw no purchase message for it.

bugs.title: Probe recorded a failed check with no detail
bugs.evidence: The counters show checks_failed=1 (checks_passed=10) with an empty errors list, so the failing check is not identified.
